name: status
title: Status
summary: Names a state with words and a mark in the state's color.
use: In meta lines, list labels, table cells and next to anything that has a state.
anatomy: Mark: a dot or the status icon

options.name: tone
options.description: accent only for the page's own status, such as Beta or New.

options.name: mark
options.description: icon uses circle-check, triangle-alert, circle-x and circle-info.

options.name: appearance
options.description: label is mono uppercase; text follows the surrounding type.

rules: Color never carries a state alone; the words always name it.
One mark per status, before the words.
The words stay ink or muted; only the mark takes the color.
accessibility: The mark is hidden from assistive technology; the words carry the meaning.
